comment_regular: Generic NiD3DShader vtable +0x44 geometry-finish callback used by Lighting30 and other shaders. It restores D3DRS_LIGHTING (state 0x89) from the shader's saved field, then restores every state recorded by the shader render-state group. The renderer invokes it even when BeginPassLoop returned zero.
